title: Reduce 222-WIC-8106 Output Ramp Rate to Minimise CV-005 Surging

fields.nextAction: PTS to review implementation 25/09; confirm proceed or cancel
fields.statusConflict: Form attributes CV-005 surging to the PID; 28/08 review found no evidence of this
fields.why:
222-WIC-8106 is producing significant reclaim feed surges on CV-005 during feed rate increases. Trend data shows the controller operating at a stable setpoint of 260 t/h while measured feed rate periodically spikes to approximately 640 t/h, despite relatively small controller output changes (~63-66% CV).
The behaviour indicates reclaim feeder demand is increasing faster than the transport delay between FE-005/006/007/008 and the CV-005 weightometer feedback can respond. Additional feeder demand is applied before the effect of previous output changes is measured, resulting in material being delivered to CV-005 in large slugs rather than a controlled increase in feed.
fields.design:
Modify the positive output ramping of 222-WIC-8106 Crushed Ore Stockpile Reclaim Feed Rate Controller to better match reclaim system deadtime and reduce material slugging on CV-005.
Requested Functionality:
- Conduct P&ID control loop tuning to reduce rate of responsiveness
fields.impact: Less operator intervention needed to manage reclaim feed surges; feed increases will ramp more slowly.
